_help: The chapters of Céline's life, one per room, in route order (docs/STORY.md). title and years show on the chapter card when a story room starts and on the scrapbook pages. intro: one line on the chapter card. outro: shown on the way to the next room.

chapters.title: Mornings with Chloé
chapters.intro: Mamie's last years: the sunrise walk, the market, coffee at this table.
chapters.outro: The door to the hall swings open. Somewhere a floorboard creaks.

chapters.title: The summers with Juliette
chapters.intro: Every July: a bucket, the 7:15 bus, and a pencil mark on the door frame.
chapters.outro: Chloé trots ahead to the bedroom door, looking back to see if you follow.

chapters.title: Henri
chapters.intro: The house was quiet again. Number puzzles, dancing in socks, and trips at last.
chapters.outro: Down to the living room, where the records are.

chapters.title: Margot
chapters.intro: The family years: Sunday records, birthday cakes and stories under the lamp.
chapters.outro: The garden doors open onto dew and birdsong.

chapters.title: The first years
chapters.intro: A wedding under a lemon tree so small it needed a stick to stand up.
chapters.outro: The blue shed smells of wood and old flowers.

chapters.title: The girl at the flower stall
chapters.intro: One sunflower, every Saturday, for a whole year.
chapters.outro: The side door leads round to the front of the house, where it all began.

chapters.title: Where it began
chapters.intro: A little girl ran down this path every morning to wave at her father's boat.
chapters.outro: The gate opens. The sun is up.
